create_SlackObserver_from_config: create a SlackObserver from a Sacred config file with webhook_url and optional bot settings
create_SlackObserver_with_webhook: create a SlackObserver instance with a webhook URL to send experiment status messages to Slack
customize_SlackObserver_completed_text: customize the SlackObserver completed_text template to format experiment completion messages with custom fields
test_SlackObserver_failed_event: test the SlackObserver failed_event method to send failure notifications with error trace to Slack
review_SlackObserver_interrupted_event: review the SlackObserver interrupted_event method that posts experiment interruption status to a Slack webhook
